use_when.text: Use labels to provide short, meaningful contextual information.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Keep label text concise and easy to scan.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Use the appropriate variant to communicate different meanings or statuses.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Maintain consistent padding, height, typography, and spacing.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Use labels consistently across similar content and contexts.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Ensure sufficient contrast between the label text and background.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

use_when.text: Use labels to support content hierarchy without distracting from the primary information.
use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Do, text I71:2279;2406:461;71:2275)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use labels for long sentences or large amounts of information.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use too many labels within a single component or section.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use color as the only way to communicate meaning.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t mix inconsistent sizes, styles, or shapes for labels with the same purpose.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use labels as buttons unless they are designed and documented as interactive.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use decorative labels that do not provide meaningful information.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 71:2279 (Label Doc Frame › Don’t, text I71:2279;2406:416;71:2278)
